items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: She replaced me in California. And when they came back, she came back with them.

ctx.x: I saw Bertha and knew her very well in 1943. Did she say anything? She seems to be dead now. I don't remember what she told me exactly. She didn't make those Bertha. We didn't make any interviews you see on tape and I didn't talk to her very much about them.
I definitely went to Richmond. I have it in a book in my mother's writing. She wrote Lillian Left for Richmond. I think it's April 23. She's got the exact tape down there. So Bertha
seems I couldn't find her at all. I'm afraid she's dead now.
